title: Historical baseline: Khan et al.
source: Khan et al., cited in Journal of Education and Social Sciences, Vol. 4
abstract: The starting point for this review’s literature scan, focused on building baseline infrastructure and universal enrollment, against which the more recent shift toward skills mismatch and equity gaps is measured.

title: Bangladesh’s new government sets pathway for education reform
abstract: Policy background on the current national reform pathway that frames the environment this pilot is being run in.

title: Bangladesh must align education with decent work through coordinated reform
source: Centre for Policy Dialogue (CPD), Policy Brief
abstract: Directly informs the pilot’s job-oriented-mindset strand, framing the gap between graduate output and formal employment this survey is designed to probe.

title: Quality of primary education in a sub-district of Bangladesh
source: Directorate of Primary Education (DPE) & UNICEF, International Journal of Humanities Social Sciences and Education
abstract: A situational assessment of primary-level quality that informs the pilot’s perceptions-of-education strand.

title: Strategic Plan for Higher Education (SPHE) in Bangladesh: 2018–2030
source: Ministry of Education Bangladesh, University Grants Commission
abstract: The governing framework for tertiary reform, cited here as structural context rather than as data this pilot collects itself.

title: Bangladesh’s education system in 2026: between progress and pressure
abstract: A contemporary synthesis of the same tension (progress against pressure) that this pilot’s survey design responds to directly.
